git: do not track vim swo temp file.

Signed-off-by: Emmanuel Roullit <emmanuel.roullit@gmail.com>

test: at least one packet mmap allocation must work.

The smallest allocation allocates 8 frames, 2kB each. Even though some
systems might be memory constrained, if this cannot be achieved,
dabba will never run properly on it.

Signed-off-by: Emmanuel Roullit <emmanuel.roullit@gmail.com>

test: tolerate ENOMEM on packet mmap creation.

It is not possible to determine beforehand if the packet mmap allocation
will succeed or not. However, even on memory shortage, if must return
the proper error and keep running.

Signed-off-by: Emmanuel Roullit <emmanuel.roullit@gmail.com>

ctest: interrupt unit tests procedure on failure.

Even though, interrupting unit tests on first failure means that less
tests will be executed, it also preserve the 'trash' directory intact and
ease the debugging process.

Signed-off-by: Emmanuel Roullit <emmanuel.roullit@gmail.com>

test: fix expected amount of captured packets.

Each ICMP request will be captured once as its transmitted, once when it
is received. Same for the ICMP response.
This means that each ping will generate 4 packets. As the test moves
formward after 10, 40 packets must be captured.
